body: Remove only scripts/test-fidelity-gate-spec-reads.py and tests/fixtures/requirement-fidelity-gate/representative-reviews/r26-matrix-pilot/spec-read-log.json, with catalog, qualification and callers. Both recover at commit 020e4d2c76129ac89b488cf9436d0e6efb453f5a and identical repository-relative paths. Exact retired-path selection must retain current selector and fidelity protection; unknown siblings, recreated inputs and unsafe links must not gain a broad exemption. Preserve complete relevant clause assessment, justified bounded/full reads, current omission/compression/closed-vocabulary proof and all historical record bytes. Adapter support, replay and unrelated cleanup are excluded. Independent Proposal applicability and Design assessment remain required.

decisions.rationale: User selected the remaining VAL-SR-23 frozen-log retirement. Existing cleanup proposal and Validation direction apply unchanged; no new product direction or model is needed. Scoped test-spec amendment is new-profile-only supersession of instrumentation with unchanged historical remainder, not a retained feature behavior expansion.
